notes: Multi-file deterministic tasks designed to expose useful parallel context gathering. Prompts never mention Turbo or parallelism; every arm receives identical text and fresh seed bytes.

tasks.prompt: Read all region-*.json files in this directory and create totals.js. Export totals() using CommonJS. It must return { revenue, orders, regions }, where revenue and orders are sums and regions is the number of region files. Do not modify the JSON files or create any other file.
tasks.check: const m = require('./totals.js'); assert.deepStrictEqual(m.totals(), { revenue: 5600, orders: 55, regions: 5 })

tasks.prompt: Fix the independent bugs in range.js, clamp.js and slug.js so their exported functions match the comments in each file. Change only those three files and keep CommonJS exports.
tasks.check: const r = require('./range.js'); const c = require('./clamp.js'); const s = require('./slug.js'); assert.deepStrictEqual(r.range(3), [0,1,2]); assert(c.clamp(-1,0,5) === 0 && c.clamp(8,0,5) === 5 && c.clamp(3,0,5) === 3); assert(s.slugify('  Hello,  World! ') === 'hello-world')

tasks.prompt: Read users.json, sales.json, flags.json and limits.json, then create dashboard.js exporting buildDashboard() with CommonJS. Return { activeUsers, revenue, enabledFlags, overLimit }, where enabledFlags is an alphabetically sorted array and overLimit reports whether revenue exceeds limits.revenueWarning. Do not modify inputs or create other files.
tasks.check: const m = require('./dashboard.js'); assert.deepStrictEqual(m.buildDashboard(), { activeUsers: 3, revenue: 500, enabledFlags: ['beta','darkMode'], overLimit: true })

tasks.prompt: Read catalog-a.json, catalog-b.json, catalog-c.json and catalog-d.json. Create catalog.js exporting mergedIds() with CommonJS. It must return every id once, sorted numerically ascending. Do not modify inputs or create any other file.

Read service-api.json, service-web.json, service-worker.json and policy.json. Create audit.js exporting audit() with CommonJS. Return { services, uniqueDependencies, forbiddenHits }, where services is the number of service files, uniqueDependencies is an alphabetically sorted array, and forbiddenHits contains sorted strings in the form service:name for dependencies listed in policy.forbidden. Do not modify inputs or create other files.
tasks.check: const m = require('./audit.js'); assert.deepStrictEqual(m.audit(), { services: 3, uniqueDependencies: ['bullmq','fastify','lodash','react','request'], forbiddenHits: ['worker:request'] })

tasks.prompt: Read config-dev.json, config-test.json, config-stage.json and config-prod.json. Create matrix.js exporting missingRequired() with CommonJS. Required keys are host, port and secure. Return an object whose keys are environment names and values are alphabetically sorted missing keys; omit environments with nothing missing. Do not modify inputs or create other files.
